non_existent_dependencies.pattern: Depends(function_name) where function_name is not imported or defined
non_existent_dependencies.impact: Endpoint hangs indefinitely - user sees timeout, no error logs
non_existent_dependencies.prevention: Check all functions in Depends() have imports before commit

auth_scheme_mixing.pattern: Using old Depends(get_current_*) alongside new role template auth
auth_scheme_mixing.impact: Conflicting auth schemes cause hangs or permission errors
auth_scheme_mixing.prevention: Use ONLY new role templates, remove all old Depends(get_current_*)

rule_updates.description: Architect agent must scan all Depends(...) calls and verify the function exists in imported modules. Reject if undefined.
rule_updates.implementation: Parse decorator args, extract function names, check against module imports before architecture approval

rule_updates.description: Reject endpoints that mix old Depends(get_current_*) with new role template @dependencies
rule_updates.implementation: If file has both old and new auth patterns, require choosing one and removing the other

detection_improvements: Scan all FastAPI @router decorators for dependencies parameter
Extract Depends(...) function names from both @router and function parameters
Cross-reference against imported modules (from app.core.dependencies import X)
Flag if function name not found in imports as CRITICAL
Check for auth mixing: if role templates present, flag any remaining Depends(get_current_*)
Provide actionable fix: 'Undefined dependency get_current_hr_or_admin - either import it or remove it'
learning_insights: Non-existent dependencies cause silent hangs (no exception in logs) - very hard to debug
Hangs happen at FastAPI dependency resolution phase, before endpoint code runs
Backend logs show NOTHING when dependency fails - request just times out
Frontend users see 'connection timeout' or 'internal server error' after 10-30 seconds
Real incident: 3+ hours debugging to find unused old auth function in Depends()
Prevention is better than debugging - architect agent must catch this before gate
